summary.text: Dru Tarr (Andrew Tarr) is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives who has represented the 5th Essex District since April 2026 and is running for a full term on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Tarr won the Democratic primary in the special election for the 5th Essex District on March 3, 2026, defeating Sarah Wilkinson, and then won the special general election on March 31, 2026, defeating Republican Christina Delisio and unenrolled candidate Gilbert Frieden.
He assumed office on April 15, 2026, and advanced from the regular Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
